content: GoReleaser v2 (current: v2.16) is the standard Go binary distribution tool. Use goreleaser-action@v7 in GitHub Actions with version: '~> v2'. Build matrix defaults to linux/darwin/windows + amd64/arm64. fetch-depth: 0 required for changelog. Triggers on git tags (tags: ['*']). Produces GitHub Release assets with checksums. Supports GOFLAGS, ldflags, CGO_ENABLED=0 for fully static binaries. .goreleaser.yaml config starts with version: 2. Also produces .deb/.rpm packages, Homebrew taps, Scoop manifests if configured. cosign signature verification requires >= v2.13.0.
